title: Job Queue: resume interrupted finalization on task retry
summary: Job Queue Dispatcher now resumes interrupted finalization when a task retries after a lock timeout, preventing recurring jobs from being permanently stuck in the Finished state without scheduling their next recurrence.
key_points: Detects when a task retry occurs after finalization failure by checking for In Process or Success log entries matching the System Task ID
Resumes bookkeeping to finalize the log entry and call FinalizeRun to schedule the next recurrence or delete non-recurring entries
Only acts on entries that are Finished, have Manual Recurrence off, and have a matching log entry, leaving other Finished entries untouched
Emits new telemetry signal 0000WW6 to track when job queue entry finalization is resumed
Includes new tests covering recurring entry rescheduling, non-recurring entry deletion, and entries left untouched when no log entry exists
quote: A recurring Job Queue Entry can stop being scheduled forever.
